name: CubingUSA Mid-Atlantic FMC Championship 2023
information:
The only event being held at this competition is 3x3x3 Fewest Moves. For a more normal competition experience, check out [CubingUSA Mid-Atlantic Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MidAtlanticChampionship2023).

Podiums and champions from this competition will be recognized during the awards ceremony at CubingUSA Mid-Atlantic Championship 2023.

This competition will take place at different venues across the Mid-Atlantic region. Please see the Locations tab for more details.
